findings.title: Unusual behaviour in bm_low
findings.summary: bm_low (prio 10) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 79 of its 80 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 80 ms. It stands out in: longest wait for a CPU (higher than healthy), time waiting for a CPU (higher than healthy), time asleep (lower than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is healthy_irq_deferred (distance 0.18, inside the 0.852 typical for that pattern).
findings.qnx_note: Learned from healthy QNX 8.0 traces: this thread behaved unlike any healthy run in the features listed. It is not a proven bug and gets no automatic fix: look at the timeline around it. Any resemblance to a known pattern is measured against labelled example windows, never a rule that fired.
